caveat: Gene-set membership is real mouse annotation. Any assignment of these gene symbols to anonymous synthetic SIM identifiers is arbitrary demonstration metadata; all resulting enrichment values have no experimental biological interpretation.
extraction: RData gene_sets_mouse: use sparse matrix columns where gene_set_info.database == BioSystems-kegg; accession identifiers all mmu; map sparse row positions to gene_info.Symbol; unique symbols within each pathway. Column identities were verified against sparse matrix Dimnames. No human-to-mouse orthology conversion. Retain only canonical pathway accessions matching ^mmu[0-9]{5}$; exclude all 89 mmu_M module accessions (402 BioSystems-kegg entries become 313 pathways).
identifier_type: Mouse gene symbols; archived nomenclature from package snapshot
source_version_limitation: Archived NCBI BioSystems collection, not the current KEGG release. Exact constituent KEGG release was not recorded by this mirror. Update from direct KEGG/mmu source before experimental analysis. NCBI mouse gene_info documented download 2020-10-15.
license: Mirror R package MIT; original KEGG data remain subject to KEGG terms. Do not interpret package source-code license as relicensing constituent annotation.
direct_source_unavailable: https://rest.kegg.jp/link/mmu/pathway and Enrichr HTTPS requests returned tunnel 403; no verification was disabled.
